query:
select u.id as user_id, u.email,
                   exists (
                       select 1 from user_totp_credentials t
                       where t.user_id = u.id and t.confirmed_at is not null
                   ) as "mfa_enabled!"
            from users u
            where u.deleted_at is null
              and ($1::uuid is null or u.id < $1)
            order by u.id desc
            limit $2
